# E001: a name is declared twice

**Severity:** error · **Stage:** validator

Elements and infrastructure nodes share one namespace, so each name may be declared once. The secondary label points at the first declaration.

## Failing example

```saxl
system Shop
service Web
store Web
```

## Fixed example

```saxl
system Shop
service Web
store WebDB
```
